title: Casper and the Crown
author: Rafael Pemberton
blurb: Vesper Vane, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
